1	# CreativeHub — Online courses for creative professionals
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	CreativeHub is the largest creative learning community offering thousands of online courses taught by world-class professionals in design, illustration, photography, crafts, and more. The platform empowers creative professionals, designers, illustrators, photographers, and hobbyists to learn new skills at their own pace through high-quality video instruction and a vibrant community.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #F02D00 (primary red-orange), #171717 (dark foreground), #FFFFFF (white)
     7	
     8	Tone: Bold, modern, professional
     9	
    10	## Featured Specializations
    11	Carousel of featured specialization bundles displayed on the homepage hero section. Each includes title, description, student count, rating, original price, and discounted price.
    12	
    13	| Specialization | Description | Students | Rating | Original | Sale Price |
    14	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    15	| Graphic Design and Visual Communication | Master color, composition, and visual perception to create impactful and coherent visual identities. | 26,264 | 100% (337) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    16	| Sewing and Design Specialization | Master sewing techniques: from using a sewing machine to creating garments like dresses, trousers, and backpacks. | 16,058 | 100% (69) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    17	| Social Media Marketing Specialization | Learn to design, manage, and execute effective social media campaigns with targeted objectives and performance analytics. | 12,900 | 99% (73) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    18	| Sketching Techniques Specialization | Explore the power of sketching alongside top-notch drawing masters. | 12,796 | 99% (129) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    19	| UX/UI Design Specialization | Create engaging digital experiences with UX design through research, methodology, and strategy for your portfolio. | 8,880 | 100% (81) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    20	
    21	All specializations are labeled "FREE WITH" (Plus membership) and show 99% discount badges.
    22	
    23	## Best Seller Courses
    24	Grid of best-selling courses with course title, instructor, student count, rating, price, and "Best seller" badge.
    25	
    26	- **Drawing for Beginners Level -1** — by Puño · 274,195 students · 99% (10.47K) · $0.50 (was $29.99)
    27	- **Modern Watercolor Techniques** — by Ana Victoria Calderon · 228,801 students · 99% (10.21K) · $0.50
    28	- **Professional Photography for Instagram** — by Mina Barrio · 282,895 students · 99% (10.89K) · $0.50
    29	- **Creative Drawing Techniques for Beginners** — by Puño · 177,842 students · 99% (4.52K) · $0.50
    30	- **Introduction to After Effects** — by Carlos "Zenzuke" Albarrán · 296,236 students · 97% (4.93K) · $0.50
    31	- **Introduction to Adobe Photoshop** — by Carles Marsal · 381,277 students · 100% (10.16K) · $0.50
    32	
    33	## Course Engagement Stats
    34	Key metrics displayed on course cards across the platform:
    35	
    36	- **274,195** — student enrollments (Drawing for Beginners)
    37	- **99%** — average satisfaction rating
    38	- **$0.50** — promotional course price
    39	- **98% Disc.** — typical discount percentage shown
    40	- **282,895** — student enrollments (Professional Photography for Instagram)
    41	
    42	## Platform Value Propositions
    43	Section title: "What to expect from a CreativeHub course"
    44	
    45	- **Learn at your own pace** — Enjoy learning from home without a set schedule and with an easy-to-follow method. You set your own pace.
    46	- **Get front-row seats** — Videos of the highest quality, so you don't miss a single detail. With unlimited access, you can watch them as many times as you need to perfect your technique.
    47	- **Learn from the best professionals** — Learn valuable methods and techniques explained by top experts in the creative sector.
    48	- **Share knowledge and ideas** — Ask questions, request feedback, or offer solutions. Share your learning experience with other students in the community.
    49	- **Meet expert teachers** — Each expert teaches what they do best, with clear guidelines, true passion, and professional insight in every lesson.
    50	- **Connect with a global creative community** — The community is home to millions of people from around the world who are curious and passionate about exploring and expressing their creativity.
    51	- **Earn a certificate with every course (Plus)** — Get a custom certificate signed by your teacher for every course. Share it on your portfolio or social media.
    52	- **Watch professionally produced courses** — CreativeHub curates its teacher roster and produces every course in-house to ensure a high-quality online learning experience.
    53	
    54	## Course Categories
    55	Sidebar navigation listing all course categories with sub-sections for Areas and Software filters.
    56	
    57	**Categories:** Illustration · Craft · Marketing & Business · Photography & Video · Design · 3D & Animation · Architecture & Spaces · Writing · Fashion · Web & App Design · Calligraphy & Typography · Music & Audio · Culinary · Artificial Intelligence · Wellness
    58	
    59	**Areas:** Branding & Identity · Graphic Design · Social Media Design · Web Design · Color Theory · Traditional Illustration · Digital Illustration · Drawing · Arts & Crafts · Fine Arts · Photography · Marketing · Painting
    60	
    61	**Software:** Canva · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Illustrator · Procreate · Adobe After Effects · SketchUp · Cinema 4D · Figma · Blender
    62	
    63	**Course Types:** All courses · Guided courses · Deep Dive · Specializations · Basics · New courses · Top rated · Popular courses
    64	
    65	## Subscription Pricing
    66	Toggle between Yearly and Monthly plans.
    67	
    68	| Detail | Yearly | Monthly |
    69	|---|---|---|
    70	| Price | $14.59/month | $33.90/month |
    71	| Billed as | $174.50/year | $33.90/month |
    72	| Savings | **SAVE 57%** | — |
    73	| Plus credits | 12 per year | 1 per month |
    74	
    75	Terms: Cancel subscription renewal whenever you want. After one year, renewal price will be the full amount of $349.
    76	
    77	## Plus Membership Benefits
    78	- **+1,000 courses FREE** — Watch thousands of courses for free across Illustration, Photography, Crafts, Marketing, Design, Architecture, Web & App Design, and more.
    79	- **100+ new courses added every week** — Choose from a catalog of courses that Plus subscribers can watch for free for at least 30 days.
    80	- **12 annual credits** — Receive credits to redeem for any course on the platform. Use them immediately or save for later.
    81	- **Certificate per course** — When you complete a purchased course, instantly get your personalized certificate signed by the teacher.
    82	- **Exchange it now, or later** — Use your credits as soon as you get them or save them. You have a whole year.
    83	- **Get exclusive savings** — Buy credits and use them to pay for courses. Always save at least 20%.
    84	
    85	## Plus FAQ
    86	Expandable accordion with questions and answers about the Plus subscription.
    87	
    88	- **What courses can Plus members watch for free?** — Plus members can watch thousands of courses for free, with 100+ new courses added to the Plus catalog every week. Courses are free to watch for a limited time period. You can always buy a course to keep it forever.
    89	- **How do Plus credits work?** — You'll get one credit each month (monthly) or 12 credits per year (annual), starting the day you subscribe. Credits accumulate and can be exchanged for any course regardless of price. Credits expire one year after receipt or when membership ends. Once redeemed, the course is yours forever.
    90	- **When will I get my certificate?** — When you complete a purchased course, you'll instantly get your personalized certificate. Download as PDF or share online. Includes your name, course title, QR code linking to your project, and teacher's signature.
    91	- **What's the difference between the yearly and monthly subscription?** — Benefits are exactly the same, but the yearly payment offers a 14% discount.
    92

     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

You'll get one credit each month (monthly) or 12 credits per year (annual), starting the day you subscribe. Credits accumulate and can be exchanged for any course regardless of price. Credits expire one year after receipt or when membership ends. Once redeemed, the course is yours forever.

When you complete a purchased course, you'll instantly get your personalized certificate. Download as PDF or share online. Includes your name, course title, QR code linking to your project, and teacher's signature.

Benefits are exactly the same, but the yearly payment offers a 14% discount. With yearly you pay $174.50 upfront (equivalent to $14.59/month) versus $33.90/month on the monthly plan.

steps.message:
The **CreativeHub** 5-page portfolio website is complete and all files are in `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Pages Delivered
| Page | File | Key Features |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Home** | `index.html` | Hero specialization carousel (5 slides), best-seller course carousel, new courses carousel, 8 value propositions, dismissible promo countdown banner |
| **Courses** | `courses.html` | Sidebar filtering (Categories, Areas, Software, Course Types), mobile filter toggle, featured/illustration/design/photography/marketing/new course rows |
| **Projects** | `projects.html` | Masonry gallery (3-column responsive), sort dropdown (Featured/Most liked/Most comments/Most viewed/Most recent), time & creative field filters, 12 project cards with real data |
| **Plus** | `plus.html` | Pricing toggle (Yearly $14.59/mo vs Monthly $33.90/mo), savings badge, course catalog carousel, credits feature carousel, certificates section, pricing comparison table, FAQ accordion |
| **Login** | `login.html` | Facebook/Apple social login, email/password form, password visibility toggle, "Join for Free" link to Plus |

### Shared Systems
- **`styles.css`** — Full design system with brand colors (#F02D00, #171717), Inter font, card components, carousel/scroll-carousel, accordion, pricing cards, responsive footer grid + mobile footer accordion
- **`main.js`** — All interactions: hero carousel auto-advance, horizontal scroll carousels, FAQ accordion, mobile nav, countdown banner, sidebar category filtering, project sort/filter, Plus pricing toggle, password visibility toggle

### Responsive & Accessibility
- Mobile-first responsive design with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px
- Sticky header, semantic HTML, aria-labels on interactive elements
- Footer collapses into accordions on mobile (`< 768px`)
- All pages link to each other with relative paths
